text.autoconfig.autogg.title: AutoGG
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.commandTem: Full command to run. Must include {player}. Placeholders:
{player} = target username (last you hit, else last who hit you)
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.message.@T: Inserted where {message} appears in the template
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.hitMemoryS: Applies to both last player you hit and last who hit you.
0 = remember until you leave the server
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.maxDistanc: 0 = no distance check. Only if the player is still loaded.
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.requirePla: If on, skips send when the target player is gone or dead
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.allowLastA: Prefer the last player you hit.
If none, use the last player who hit you.
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.spearLater: How far beside the look ray a spear near-miss can still count. Default 1.0.
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.antiSpamEn: Blocks keybind spam with a cooldown between successful sends
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.cooldownSe: Minimum wait between successful AutoGG sends.
text.autoconfig.autogg.option.maxSendsPe: How many times you can message the same engagement before needing a new hit.
autogg.feedback.none: No recent combat target (hit someone or get hit first)
autogg.feedback.too_far: Target player is too far away
autogg.feedback.already_sent: Already messaged this target — hit again first
